plan: A wolf jungler who tracks wounded enemies and heals a huge amount during fights.
aSurveiller: His R (Infinite Duress). He leaps from afar and locks you in place for a moment: keep an escape spell or an ally to help you.
contrer: Below half health, go back to base: he detects you and becomes faster against you (W).
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: he heals a huge amount in fights.
Don't drag out a duel when he's low on health: his passive heals him even more.
forces: Heals a huge amount in fights.
His R locks a target down from afar.
faiblesses: His leap (R) is easy to see coming from far away.

sorts.P: His attacks heal him when he is low on health.
sorts.Q: Bite that damages based on your max health and heals him.
sorts.W: Detects wounded enemies and gains speed against them.
sorts.E: Reduces damage taken, then makes nearby enemies flee.
sorts.R: Leaps and locks down the first champion hit.

momentFort: Very solid in duels thanks to his healing, but rarely ganks before level 6. As soon as his R is up, he pounces on wounded lanes.
